role: Source review of an unresolved legacy tab-label ownership/constructor conflict. Proposed TemplatePortal implementation was withdrawn before commit; no runtime changes or token ownership are claimed.
historical_constructor: templateRef, viewContainerRef, optional MAT_TAB; super(templateRef, viewContainerRef)
shared_public_base: TemplatePortal exposes the original inherited portal behavior directly; CdkPortal16 adds only its own directive factory/metadata and the same two-argument super call, not another portal algorithm. Current MatTabLabel and CdkPortal use inject-based constructors absent in the original legacy constructor contract.

minimum_peer_proof.contract: Public nondeprecated TemplatePortal(templateRef,viewContainerRef,context?,injector?); original two arguments remain supported. Angular21 is qualified only through Actions at this floor, not by installing the read-only package.
public_exports: export { CdkPortal, CdkPortalOutlet, CdkPortalOutletAttachedRef, ComponentType, Portal, PortalModule, PortalOutlet } from './_portal-directives-chunk.js';
export { BasePortalOutlet, ComponentPortal, DomPortal, DomPortalOutlet, TemplatePortal };

query_body: Existing parent queries still use the peer label and private MAT_TAB token; changing the provider token alone leaves MatTabLabel._closestTab null and breaks the original nearest-tab guard.
qualification: Open engineering finding; not a token, API, lifecycle, G11 or complete-audit pass. No runtime source or acceptance matrix changed.

proposed_heritage_waiver_removal_not_app.rationale: The owned class extends a different base than the 16.2.14 declaration. Only this exact extends pair is accepted.

rejected_alternative: Extending public TemplatePortal with the original three-argument constructor restores manual construction and portal methods, but removes instanceof current MatTabLabel/CdkPortal. No frozen inheritance identity change is authorized by restoring a declaration waiver or matching flattened signatures.
current_peer_diagnostic: Read-only current CDK22.1.7 CdkPortal constructor() injects TemplateRef/ViewContainerRef. CDK21.2.14 declaration constructor(...args:unknown[]) is a compatibility constructor, not proof original explicit arguments still control the instance. Required stable public surface and minimum behavior constraints remain unresolved.
proposed_packed_case_not_added: Three real label directives (two outer, one nested) have three distinct nearest tabs, attached TemplatePortal instances, own token providers and matching parent.templateLabel; modern label token absent. Existing harness selection still finds two outer tabs and selects Two.
